notes:
=== PASS 1 (2026-08-29/30, interrupted by weekly limit, resumed) ===

MY PLAN SPEC WAS WRONG AND THE BUILDER CAUGHT IT BY MEASURING. S B5 specified FIVE RADIX-2^26 LIMBS, the textbook Poly1305 decomposition. It is NOT IMPLEMENTABLE HERE: MUL/MULHI are SIGNED (measured on chip: 0x0002 x 0xFFFF -> 0xFFFFFFFE), so an exact unsigned 16x16->32 product needs BOTH operands under 2^15. A radix-2^26 limb alone blows that, and radix 2^13 fails too -- the limb fits but the FOLDED COEFFICIENT 5 x 8191 = 0x9FFB does not. RADIX 2^10 / 13 LIMBS is the only survivor keeping 2^130 = 5 limb-aligned (10 x 13 = 130). This signedness was NOWHERE in the knowledge base, which is exactly why my spec got it wrong. Now INV-57, gated in test_poly1305_golden.py, and I have CORRECTED THE PLAN DOC in place with the reasoning rather than leaving a known-wrong spec to guide the next builder.

FOUR MEASURED FINDINGS, all now invariants:
  INV-57 MUL/MULHI signed -> both operands under 2^15.
  INV-58 A 32-bit MAC is 7 instructions and must compute the HIGH HALF FIRST -- MULHI destroys the carry, and the wrong order leaves the LOW WORD BIT-EXACT, invisible to a one-word gate. That is the campaign's recurring shape yet again. Also: a systolic stage cannot adopt-and-forward in one entry (wrong in all 6 step orders x 2 trigger orders); sweeps must be staged AND fired in REVERSE ring order (forward left 12 of 13 cells exact).
  INV-59 A PROGRAMMED cell on a broadcast walk stops the sweep dead; only a face-only transit_* is transparent.
  INV-60 Read the hop the BUILD resolved. A manhattan hop GUESS instead of the build's input_landings gave 8 events and no state change and looked exactly like a dead block; the bitstream was correct and survived full disassembly. The resolved landing gave 1445 events. A HARNESS bug presenting as a block bug.

IT EXTENDED INV-56 (which I forwarded from ChaCha20): the SAME layout reported Deadlock on some inputs and QueueEmpty on others, so 'read stop_reason' must be 'read it for EVERY case', not once.

TWO MEASURED DEAD ENDS: a dedicated x5 wrap CELL cannot be ordered between sweeps by any trigger placement (the fold must ride the producing cell's forward); and folding the egress onto a MAC cell corrupted ONLY THAT CELL's accumulator -- 12/13 correct, exactly the shape a one-value gate misses.

HONEST INTERFACE LIMIT the builder flagged: the input is a 16-bit WORD stream, so odd-byte messages are not expressible (3 of 9 S A.3 vectors), gated at the golden instead. LAYER: block interface, FIXABLE.

ORCHESTRATOR VERIFICATION: I checked whether the on-chip claims were backed by committed code and they are NOT -- those experiments ran in scratch and were not committed, so they are not reproducible from the tree. That is a REPRODUCIBILITY GAP, not fabrication: the committed gate file opens by stating plainly 'this file does NOT gate a built chip', names every unbuilt phase, and keeps the block out of the catalog. The discipline worked. Next pass must COMMIT the on-chip harness, not just run it.
